beats.headline: Lexis, speaking for Odette
beats.text: There is talk. A woman called Lexis, speaking for a woman called Odette, tells the man and the cat that the Queen of the High Elves will most likely prove to be one of your repurposed humans, and that with the one called Bea accounted for, nobody can say which. She also says I am a country boss, placed to zero out the best of you at the Butcher's Masquerade. I am Imogen. I am giving a party. The rest is gossip.

beats.headline: Her familiar is Ferdinand
beats.text: My familiar is Ferdinand. My elves are out among the creepers when they come upon the man's party, and Ferdinand takes exception to the dinosaur and strikes at it. The cat puts herself between them and takes the blast. She should not have got up from that. She does, on some cockroach's trick of hers, and she is quite well. I am told this with some amazement. I do not share it.

beats.headline: My half-sister, in a cart
beats.text: My guards go into the last wagon and find a robed woman wearing my half-sister's face. They do not touch her. I come instead. I fade into the man's wagon beside a girl who squeaks and throws up a shield, and I ask him whether he is really attempting to smuggle someone who looks like my half-sister into my castle. He says your majesty and struggles to swallow.

beats.headline: I want that boon
beats.text: The man knows nothing of why it is called the Butcher's Masquerade, so I tell him: Apito's first party, Yarilo's breach, the slaughter after. Only the most divine may cast the spell, and only once in their lives. The goddess writes the guest list, and if the evening ends without violence, the boon is mine. I want it. I may not harm my guests before the party. I do not need to. Whoever breaks the peace, the ground opens under them.

beats.headline: She takes a chair before the stage
beats.text: I appear in the ballroom with blood down my gown, and my familiar is not where he belongs; now that I am at the party he is locked in with the rest of my staff. My sister has her invitation. Let her enjoy it. I draw the man across the floor to me and hold him in the air. My castle is besieged: his changelings at my towers, his friends in the trees. I turn to leave, and stop. I sit before the stage. Proceed.

beats.headline: Red lightning
beats.text: My sister's tattoos swarm around me and cannot touch me. I answer with red lightning in every direction at once. Then I push out of the mess of them. You fools. I swipe my hand and the man's arm snaps, and I draw him to me through the air, breaking. My own familiar strikes my head. I strike him away.

beats.headline: Her crystal changes hands
beats.text: Queen Imogen's memorial crystal has changed hands. Someone named Osvaldo took it off her, and she was in no condition to argue the point. Prepotente would like it next and is going after him for it. A queen's treasure, and it goes to whoever is standing closest when she goes down. That is how this floor works. That is how every floor works.
